title: Fardeen Khan, Mahesh Manjrekar Join Star-Studded Malamaal Weekly 2 Cast
excerpt: The Bollywood comedy sequel assembles Riteish Deshmukh, Paresh Rawal, Raveena Tandon, Parineeti Chopra, and Shilpa Shirodkar alongside new additions, with filming set for November 2026.
body:
• Fardeen Khan and Mahesh Manjrekar are the latest additions to Malamaal Weekly 2, joining a cast that already includes Riteish Deshmukh, Paresh Rawal, Rajpal Yadav, and Elvish Yadav.
  • Raveena Tandon, Parineeti Chopra, and Shilpa Shirodkar — returning to Bollywood after 26 years — round out the female leads.
  • Amit Joshi of Teri Baaton Mein Aisa Uljha Jiya fame will direct the sequel, which is set to begin shooting in November 2026.
  • The film is not a direct sequel but retains the original's core comic premise: ordinary people in a small town driven to chaos by the prospect of sudden wealth.

The cast of Malamaal Weekly 2 keeps growing. Fardeen Khan and Mahesh Manjrekar have signed on for the Bollywood comedy sequel, Bollywood Hungama reported on August 14, adding two experienced names to what is shaping up as one of the most ensemble-heavy Hindi comedies in recent years.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=iu5NPtLk2RI

An Expanding Ensemble

The casting announcements have rolled out steadily over the past two weeks. Raveena Tandon and Parineeti Chopra were confirmed on August 7. Shilpa Shirodkar's signing on August 11 marked her return to Hindi cinema after a 26-year gap — she later appeared to confirm the news through a playful exchange with co-star Paresh Rawal on X. On August 13, Riteish Deshmukh, Elvish Yadav, Paresh Rawal, and Rajpal Yadav were locked in as the male leads.

https://x.com/Bollyhungama/status/2088256963742413036

With Fardeen Khan and Manjrekar now onboard, the full announced cast stands at nine principal actors, mixing Bollywood veterans with newer faces.

"Fardeen is on a roll since his comeback. He's quite loved in comic capers. Hence, the makers were keen to have the dashing and talented actor on board."

— Source close to the production, Bollywood Hungama

Behind the Camera

Amit Joshi, who co-directed Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon's robotic rom-com Teri Baaton Mein Aisa Uljha Jiya (2024), has been signed to helm the sequel. He is currently fine-tuning the script ahead of a planned November 2026 production start.

The original Malamaal Weekly (2006), directed by Priyadarshan, was a box office surprise. Made on a budget of roughly ₹7 crore, the comedy about greedy villagers scrambling to claim a dead man's lottery winnings grossed approximately ₹42.7 crore worldwide. It was later remade in Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam, with Priyadarshan himself directing the Malayalam version, Aamayum Muyalum (2014).

New Story, Same Spirit

Malamaal Weekly 2 is not a direct sequel. The characters and setting will be entirely new, though the thematic engine remains the same — a group of ordinary people in a small town, driven by poverty and greed, find themselves caught in an increasingly chaotic scramble for a large sum of money.

The inclusion of Elvish Yadav, the YouTube content creator and Bigg Boss OTT Season 2 winner, signals a bid to bridge Bollywood's traditional comedy audience with digital-first viewership. This will be Yadav's second film after his debut alongside Tiger Shroff.

Fardeen Khan's Second Innings

For Fardeen Khan, the role continues a comeback that has gathered momentum since his return to the screen. Khan, who stepped away from Bollywood in 2010, has taken on roles across genres, but comedy remains a sweet spot — his turns in films like No Entry (2005) and Heyy Babyy (2007) cemented his reputation for comic timing.

Manjrekar, known primarily as a filmmaker (Vaastav, Astitva) and character actor, brings versatility. Production sources described his role as "quirky" and expressed confidence audiences would respond to his comic turn.

What's Next

Shooting is planned to begin in November 2026. While Riteish Deshmukh has been verbally confirmed as a lead, he is reportedly still reviewing the script and has yet to sign formally. Further casting announcements are expected in the coming weeks as the production finalizes its ensemble.
